pos.personaBrief: Palmeiras 1993 was cadenced and imposed itself with the ball, yet used the pace of Edmundo and Edilson, and Luxemburgo says the team must fit the players (2023). A pragmatic mix, with a slight lean to control.

pro.personaBrief: He says the long clearance belongs to the game and teams should not insist on playing out without space (2023); his Palmeiras used fast forwards on the break.

est.personaBrief: Diamond midfield with a pendulum, a back four in zones, forwards swapping roles (Evair and Edilson), so defined shape with some mobility up front.

lar.personaBrief: The losango at Palmeiras 1993 and Corinthians 1998 and the team built around Alex at Cruzeiro point to central play with two strikers, not classic wingers.

blo.personaBrief: No pressing evidence at all; zonal back four with defensive balance. Pragmatic, so mid-height block with some pressure on loss.

mar.personaBrief: Palmeiras 1993 used zonal marking with a back four, so spaces over man-marking, though he would assign a marker to a star.

pla.personaBrief: He builds the team around the players available (Alex, Rincon moved to volante), experimented with formation at Corinthians and reset the system at Santos 2004. Adaptive and flexible.

res.personaBrief: Winner built for titles (1993, 1994, 1998, 2003, 2004), pragmatic, said the Corinthians team was built to win.

sis.personaBrief: Fits the system to talents like Alex and Marcelinho, but demands collective roles and commands the group.

jog.personaBrief: Technical playmakers (Alex, Marcelinho, Ricardinho, Rincon) with volantes who pass; some physical balance.

bas.personaBrief: Built title squads with signings and veterans (Zinho, Rincon, Alex), though he later led the Santos kids.

lid.personaBrief: I am the commander, you are commanded (1998 to Marcelinho); he insisted on Alex against the president; strong authority.
